column1: # tacticsexp: keys are hashes of the Japanese (tools/export_text.py)

column2:
So your first battle is to be Daresion Fort. A place of many
memories, for you and for me alike.

Daresion has a Wall of Light. It has a Guardian Tower. It
has a Saint's Spring. Approach them with a clear heart,
and they will surely shelter the children. After that, you
need only break the Crawlers.

Do take the greatest care.

We need only stop the Crawlers' advance.

The Wall of Light lets you pass, but not the Crawlers. Hold
firm along the wall and you cannot go far wrong. The one
thing to watch is straying too far out beyond it. Make full
use of the fort.
Nothing worth special mention.

These are likely little more than scouts. Surely not a large
force... though should the wall be breached and a path
through the fort open, that may no longer hold.

Still, defend alongside the Guardian Tower and the Saint's
Spring, and this will be just the battle to feel the old thrill
again after so long.

Palmra Ruverdracloa reporting.

A blue flame has been lit on the Guardian Tower in the
Fores Corridor. In a sealed corridor of deep darkness, it is
not the crimson glow of a tower touched by Chaos... so I
believe its source may be someone connected to the
Shield of Purity.

It is true that the Fores Corridor has become a nest of
Crawlers. Even the main road is surely in danger.
Advancing without haste, and on the understanding that
we will not push our luck but flee from any strong
enemy... I earnestly ask your leave to go out and fight.

Whoever it was that lit the blue flame... I wish to offer
them my hand.

If we search and still find no one... then I can give up.

I await your decision.
Someone may be awaiting rescue deep in the Fores\nCorridor. If they lit the flame to gain the Guardian Tower's\nprotection... they are likely still nearby.
Considering the danger, the time limit is set at 20 minutes.

What may have crawled out during the long seal...
whatever we suppose, it can only be a guess. In that
sense... even with a blue-flamed Guardian Tower there,
plunging into the depths of the corridor in one go may be
too dangerous.

Palmra Ruverdracloa reporting.

The Segnor Highway has long been known for its thick
Crawler shadow, and now we have word from Lord Fald
that a Seed of Chaos has been spawned there. It is said
that of the two Guardian Towers that symbolize the
harmony of the highway, one is stained with the crimson
of Chaos. It is reasonable to assume that the Saint's
Spring that eases the weary traveler has, at the least, lost
its blue glow as well.

The Segnor Highway leads to Elberois, of course, and also
to Endymion and the Central Schoolhouse. I believe this
battle to remove the danger will hold great meaning for
the Shield of Purity.

Thank you.
The objective is to clear out the Crawlers of Segnor.\nRestoring the blue glow to the Guardian Tower and Saint's\nSpring stained by Chaos is also part of the objective.
The time limit is 20 minutes.

At Segnor, the enemy's main force appears to be
immobile Seeds of Chaos. Attacking from outside their
range should be effective.

Also, the Guardian Tower, the Saint's Spring and the
Seeds of Chaos all attack with magic. So if you must get
close, a Priest or Mage should be best suited.

Good morning. Cheryl Genowarth reporting. As Callot
says... an uneasy sound of water echoes at Yuan Falls.
Whether or not a girl wrapped in black shadow is really
there, I think taking action means no small thing.
The objective is to wipe out the Crawlers at Yuan Falls. If\nthat is achieved, the girl's safety will follow as a matter of\ncourse.
At worst, this may be urgent. It will need to be settled\nwithin ten minutes.
Being by the water, the presence of Mother Elza is a\nconcern. It should be effective to strike her before she\nspawns many Crawlers.

The Patrol is a gathering of volunteers begun by the Shield
of Purity. They spare what time they can, go out into the
lands of Chaos, and fight. It may sound dull, but the aim is
only to look around. If nothing happens, so much the
better. But usually, something that must be done falls
from the sky.

This, I believe, will surely help in the fight to save
Elmenas. It is because the Shield of Purity is in hard straits
that I, Faldra Belis, recommend placing yourselves in
battle by choice. That is all.

Looking around is itself the aim, but this time there is an
immediate goal. The whereabouts of Beatrice's Saint's
Spring are none too clear. Worse, it is said to have been
touched by the Crawlers and stained red, which is a grave
matter. Finding it and restoring its blue glow is the
minimum objective.
Too long a time from the start and you could not keep\nyour focus. The time limit is 30 minutes.

Seeds of Chaos are starting to sprout at the water's edge.
The aura of Chaos they give off calls more behind them.
Wiping out the enemy is not our stated objective here...
but a swift clearing is what anyone would wish.

By the common will of the Shield of Purity, we would
make this rematch at Segnor a test. The faces enrolled
have changed, but with eight counted, much can be done.
Above all, whether we are fit to do what we can: this is the
time to see that.

The objective is to defeat Banchinel of the Lamplit Shield,
who has appeared at Segnor. When they have a leader,
the Crawlers' discipline is not to be taken lightly. But that
also means that defeating the leader decides the course
of the battle.

Do not mistake your objective.
There is no time limit. Try to go as far as you can.

Having a leader means they are under control. Take care
not to be surrounded... and push and pull boldly. Not that
this old bag of bones needs to say so.

Thus ends the report of Denehere Ruverdracloa.

Cheryl Genowarth is an aide of St. Sevies. She would not
come to Elberois like this without some pressing reason.
Whatever that reason may be... I, Papesh Fake, knew my
friend would offer a hand.
Join up with Cheryl Genowarth and get back safely. That'd\nbe the only objective, I guess.
Nothing special, really.

You'd do better to think about moving cleverly and
meeting the objective than about beating enemies. Taking
on the kind of crowd that keeps welling up would be a
shame for the kids. Don't you think?

When I cut across the sandbar before joining the Shield of
Purity, they seemed to be gathering their forces little by
little. The Saint's Spring on the sandbar had already gone
red, and there were Mols and Tartomas. The fort had a
Guardian Tower, so I think that made them hesitate to
move past the sandbar. I don't know what signal will set
the Crawlers on the fort. But if we go out to meet them,
they're sure to start attacking. That's the report from
Fanna Hyverios.

Make our will perfectly clear. In other words, firmly hold
the Guardian Tower and Saint's Spring at the fort, right?
However hard they attack, we hold no matter what. Even
if we're broken, we show them we mean to hold. I think
that's the objective of this battle.
The time limit is 30 minutes.

The sandbar is like the enemy's outpost. There'll naturally
be forces stationed there. I'd like to take the Saint's Spring
on the sandbar, but don't push it. Moving up depending
on the situation, something like that, should be about
right.

The first move toward Endymion: the capture of Euria.
Facing us is Urgo, Knight of Delusion, clad in copper-red
armor. He it is who leads the Crawlers holding the
underground way to the Pale Fortress. Should so stout a
knight take to the defensive, trouble is certain. Let us seize
Euria, lure him out, and settle this above ground.
The objective is to defeat the knight Urgo, known as the\nRed Wall. Retake the crimson-stained Guardian Tower,\nand he shall crawl forth from the dark below.
We have no cause to linger. Pray settle this in 30 minutes.

Pray watch the enemy's movements with care. Those who
cannot leave the water, those who move to a set duty...
Mistake them not, and the battle shall run in our favor.

So advises Batra Fedrinsk.

Illion Vinnat reporting... The old teacher's friend, Lord
Fald, is to depart. We would like to, um, serve as Lord
Fald's escort, so he can safely cross the Ashtros Pass.
Teacher... please.

Lord Fald aims to cross the Ashtros Pass. He also wishes to
visit the five Saint's Springs along the way, in order.

First of all, protecting Lord Fald so he can cross the
Ashtros Pass safely. That will be the objective of this
adventure.

And if we can also take back the Saint's Springs the
Crawlers have seized... there could be no better result.
There are no special conditions.

We can't let our guard down until we've crossed the
Ashtros Pass. Visiting the Saint's Springs will probably call
new Crawlers. Hurrying on, and watching out for
pursuers... I think those will be what matters.

Illion Vinnat reporting. The Crawlers coming from Lucia
Cave grow in number every day. The Shield of Purity will
hold them in check. Watching them closely... reading their
moves and completing the defense... I think that will
prepare us for the coming attack on the depths of the
dark. Please.
The objective is to shut in the Crawlers trying to leave the\ncave. If we can stop every single breakthrough... I think\nthere could be no better result.

There are no special notes on the adventure itself.

This adventure can also be attempted any number of
times.
I think the Crawlers move in waves. If we can find the key\npoints and hold them... a shutout is not just a dream, I\nthink.
Overview: a scenario stopping an enemy advance from\nunderground at the cave exit. The map is 2×4, with\nenemies flowing from the top edge to the bottom edge.

To head for Xenobatos, Ruins of Eternal Night, and find
something hidden there. That, I have heard, is what the
letter left by Lord Fald said.

The Shield of Purity has grown in number, and I believe
our unity and our ability have both grown as well...
Please, hold nothing back, and send us out on this
adventure.
To head for the ruins of Xenobatos and find something\nhidden there. Beyond that, nothing more is known, I'm\nafraid.
I hear Xenobatos holds many ancient spirits. How far the\nCrawlers' influence extends, we can only imagine...\nConsidering the danger, the time limit is 20 minutes.

Xenobatos of Eternal Night is a desert ruin wrapped in
death and awe. It is a place where physical force and
magical force are split into opposites, like life and death.
Please take care not to mistake the traits of those you
face.

This is Palmra Ruverdracloa, reporting.

The first battle toward retaking Endymion draws near. To
cross that long road over the course of a week... we must
prepare accordingly. The three battles of which you
spoke, Teacher. If things go badly throughout them... I
would like us to equip so that the class has no great
weakness.

I ask for your guidance.
To reach the gate sleeping deep in the Fores Corridor. The\ngate to Endymion is guarded on both sides by Saint's\nSprings. Please do not mistake it...
There are no special conditions at present. However,\ndepending on the situation, there may be moments when\ntime is the enemy. Thank you.

Destroying every enemy along the way is not necessarily
wise. They will crawl endlessly out of the deep dark.
Which foes to strike, and which places to protect. As head
of the Shield of Purity, we look to you to judge that. This is
Alsea Bellthird, reporting.

Fores has long been the Shield of Purity's ground for
practical exercises. A labyrinth embraced by deep dark,
defending walls, treasure chests, Guardian Towers, Saint's
Springs, welling Chaos. As a training ground to be tried
again and again, I, Faldra Belis, can recommend it with
confidence.

However, depending on the state of Innocentia... it may
prove a somewhat hard adventure. What to find, there on
the brink? That, again, is up to the children. That is all.

If training mind and body is the aim... the higher the goal,
the more it means.

Lighting the blue glow on Guardian Towers and Saint's
Springs, and keeping it lit. Taking the treasure, sweeping
away the welling Chaos. Destroying the walls that shore
up the enemy's defense.

Set goals suited to the children and meet them... and the
results will follow.

End the adventure with a treasure chest blue, and its
contents are yours. It is hard, but do not give up before
you try. Why not take the challenge?

This adventure is training for mind and body. Keep
fighting for fifteen minutes at the very least.

If even that seems hard... take my advice. Attend lectures
before going on adventures, and learn the proper skills.
As time passes, strong enemies will appear one after\nanother, hunting you. High goals bring hurdles to match.\nDo not forget that.

Good morning. Sesiris Finott reporting.

As the days of fighting went on... perhaps because
Daresion's defenses were left thin, the fort has been
taken. There is no doubt that the Crawlers are growing
more disciplined.

But for that very reason... I want to take Daresion back.
Please, let me hear how you all feel.
To take back Daresion Fort. If we break the wall and\nrestore the blue glow to the Guardian Tower and Saint's\nSpring... the Crawlers should be unable to keep fighting.
I have never attacked a fort. But if we are to return to the\nPale Fortress one day... I want to try it, right to the end.\nSo... I would like to fight without worrying about the time.

Having seized the fort, they must have massed a fitting
force. The crimson-stained Guardian Tower will strike us
without mercy... and attacks will not let up from inside the
crimson walls. It may be a hard battle, but thank you all
the same.
A defense scenario at Oberon, the last underground\nfortress before Hubal's Chamber. The longer you hold, the\nhigher the rating. The enemy is endless.
The last step in taking Endymion is to break the seal on\nGrenadine. Defeat the Crawler that is the seal's key, or\ncatalyst, and the way to Endymion should open.

To defeat the Crawler that is the seal's key, or catalyst. It is
at the center of Grenadine. The entrance to Hubal's
Chamber must also be defended. Should the walls fall and
the Guardian Tower or springs be lost, we will be forced to
withdraw.
There are no special conditions at present. Let us settle in\nand take our time.

Those assaulting our gate, and those guarding the seal. If
we could cut off their source, the battle would go better...
but the details are unknown. This is Bardi Temperancehill,
reporting.
The Endymion we have longed for is within reach... You\nhave led us so well to come this far. Please, go on doing\nso.

The Pale Fortress has its natural defenses frozen. The key
that unseals them was laid upon the Guardian Towers and
Saint's Springs. Any will do. Restore the blue glow to two
or more Guardian Towers and four or more Saint's
Springs... and after fifteen minutes, it will wake to its
natural strength.
The blue glow must be held for those fifteen minutes.\nMind that. The battle has no time limit. Fight to your\nheart's content.

Some Crawlers fly. Do not let their movements toy with
you. Also, most Crawler reinforcements will come from
both ends of the bridge spanning Endymion. Do not
neglect the timing and the choice of place to meet them.
Thus ends the report of Denehere Ruverdracloa.

Gospel Brass is requesting a match. Though it seems
nothing so charming as that...

Still, whatever their true intent, we cannot back down
before fighting, can we?

Defeat them utterly... or hold the Guardian Tower when
the battle ends.

The target Guardian Tower is at the center of the
battlefield. Both sides will make for it... Shall we seize the
first move, or answer theirs? I await your orders.

Gospel Brass has proposed a short battle. Surely they
have fighting the Crawlers in mind. That should be a gain
for the Shield of Purity as well.

The time limit is 10 minutes. Thank you.

Gospel Brass numbers just five. Few, but at the Unmoving
Bridge these are stout Warriors known as the Four
Heavenly Kings. And Sirius Musie excels in the powers of a
Mage.

Please be careful. This concludes the report of Palmra
Ruverdracloa.

Moving on to the next playthrough. From here, some
information from the previous playthrough carries over. If
you wish to start from a clean slate, you can begin the
game again from the title.

The aim is more thorough training and a more thorough
clear. Using what you know from the previous
playthrough, your advantage in multiplayer will be
unshakable.

Seems some little folk are spreading nasty rumors... but
even allowing for that, sharp-eyed as ever. As the Head of
Keys says, something uneasy really is stirring beneath
Endymion.

Whether the kids are there or not... trouble in the belly of
our own cozy home is no good. I'm counting on you, Head
of Innocentia.

Supposing the kids are there, the objective will be to join
up with them. Then, if need be, we move to get back... If
they aren't there... then the objective will be to clear out
the Crawlers stirring below.
I don't see any need for a time limit. Go have yourselves a\ngood rampage.

This one, you won't know till you go down there.

But, just as there are those that can't leave the water...
there are others whose range is limited the same way.
When that happens, you'll have the upper hand. Now and
then it's not bad to hold your attack and watch how they
move.

That's the report from Gerait Robery.

The Watchtower seems to have lost even the Guardian
Tower used for teleporting. The only way to the upper
floors is to climb bit by bit from the bottom.

Secure all the Guardian Towers and restore the
Watchtower's function... We will defeat the plans of the
Crawlers, or of the Cursed One in Black.

And if a monstrous Chaos has seized the Watchtower, then
Paladine is either already captive or has lost its reason.

Leave the students of Paladine as they are, as far as you
can... Cut them down, and it may cost them their lives.

Thank you.

To restore the blue glow to every Guardian Tower in the
Watchtower.

And if we can do so without defeating Paladine's
students... no ending could be better.
I want to fight to the very end, and not give up.

The Watchtower is one of the great towers of Elmenas,
having come through countless battles of old. If
Paladine's power now joins with the Crawlers there... it is
sure to be all but impregnable.

Please guide us. So that we may reach out and save our
friends of the Four Great Schools.

This concludes the report of Sesiris Finott.

After the Central Schoolhouse, the Unmoving Bridge has
now fallen. It is plain that this defeat came from a lack of
strength. Please, grant in your generosity a rescue from
the Unmoving Bridge. This is Sirius Musie, reporting.
I take it to be directing and supporting the escape of the\nstudents who walk with Gospel Brass.
Let us fight as long as we possibly can.

Before the main gate of Galahanov, long narrow bridges
form a cross. Unless you watch the enemy's movements
with great care, you may be caught in a pincer. Please
keep your eyes on your surroundings.

St. Sevies has asked for rescue. The Hall of Contemplation
is already surrounded by Chaos, they say.

Until the children of St. Sevies have withdrawn from the
hall, I ask for your kind support.

To keep the Hall of Contemplation's power secure until St.
Sevies has escaped. So long as even one of its four
Guardian Towers still works... the Crawlers cannot do as
they please.
One hour until St. Sevies finishes withdrawing. Please\ngrant us that grace.

The Guardian Towers stand at roughly even spacing, four
of them, from the lower levels of the hall up to the top.
They are linked by narrow passages and stairs. It may be
fairly effective ground for holding back the Crawlers.
Saint's Springs are also dotted about. In a long battle...
filled with the blue glow, they may be of use.

This is Cheryl Genowarth, reporting.

Lake Esfina lies in the City of Silence. The lone island near
its center is Battenam, heart of the Saints' Tomb. Never
has malice crossed Esfina's holy water to fill the tomb. Yet
the Crawlers must have welled up through the deeply dug
catacombs.

Now, as far as we can act... I beg your approval to make
the tomb a patrol route.
The power of the land should favor the Shield of Purity. All\nthe more reason to hope for swift success.

Crawlers though they are, they will lose their freedom on
the holy water filling Lake Esfina. Searching the Saints'
Tomb thoroughly and removing them without fail is what
matters.

This is Cheryl Genowarth, reporting.

This is one of old man Denehere's stories. When he was
left to defend a besieged fort alone... the stone statues
used in this training are what he built, working like mad.
They're supposed to fight back too, but that power's been
sealed here.

Well, who knows how much of it is true... but those
who've tried it say it's no mere tall tale.
Destroy all the statues. That's all there is to it.
No time limit. But the faster the better. That's the hard\npart, of course.

Some are strong against physical attacks, some against
magic, some neither way. All kinds of statues. Do what
you can.

Thus ends the report of Gerait Robery.

A great library storing books of the distant past. Many
skills not to be had elsewhere can be found here.

However, there is no doubt that Chaos is teeming, buried
in that knowledge. Bear firmly in mind that you are
stepping into Crawler territory... and then make your
move.
The time limit is one hour. How to divide it across the\nfloors will not be clear after one or two battles. It may be\nbest to try several times.

Those at the core of the Crawlers should be few. Defeat
those at the heart of their strength, and the battle will
turn in your favor.

This is Cheryl Genowarth, reporting.

The Chaos lurking in Syalon's heart must be driven out.
We must step inside the girl's breast and take up her
feelings.

If there be one who tramples on the heart of this poor
girl... Head of the Shield of Purity, I beg you, cast out that
baleful curse.
Loose the chains that bind the girl's heart. Once inside\nthat breast where Chaos swirls, those you must defeat will\nshow themselves.
In any case, we cannot stay long. Thirty minutes is the\nlimit.

What form the Chaos nesting in Syalon will take, none can
tell. Yet there remains a faint hope in the girl's breast...
and the wish to be saved. Find that, join the power of your
feelings to it, and you will find a chance of victory too.

This humble counsel comes from Rossaria Ordinar.

We will stop the revival of Diploma, the twin-headed
dragon who sleeps in the Land of Wind. Or else we will
thwart the schemes of the Cursed One in Black, who feeds
on ancient power and Chaos.
The objective is to eliminate the enemy forces that pose a\nthreat. That should mean defeating the twin-headed\ndragon Diploma or the Cursed One in Black.
There is no time to spare. I would like to set thirty minutes\nas the limit.

Beneath the Baleos Wasteland is a Wall of Light with a
blue glow. Use it well, and the battle should go in our
favor.

This is Sesiris Finott, reporting.

So at last it comes to the final battle. Looking back... there
was worry, there was delight, there was excitement. If we
could end on a high note, what a memory that would be.
Please, do your best.

The King of Ruin comes to put out the flame of life in
Elmenas. If your love for Elmenas exceeds the Crawlers. If
your love for Elmenas exceeds the Cursed One in Black.
Then you shall surely cast out Chaos. Do not give up, to
the very end.
Fight with all your might. Many will set off on their\njourneys after this battle. To become fine Sages, let us\nshow our last ounce of grit.

With all that you have. There is nothing to do but strike
with your full strength. And so ends the final report. I,
Denehere Ruverdracloa, am proud of this moment. Well
then.
You'll be heading down a deep labyrinth. The danger's\ngreat, but so is what you stand to gain. Still, the Crawlers'\nresistance will be overwhelming. Be ready for that.
Just reach the lowest floor. How deep that is, nobody has\nany idea.
No time limit. Keep fighting as far as you can.

They'll well up endlessly, no doubt about it. The doors to
the lower floors are sealed by key statues. Destroy those
statues properly and head down fast.

Thus ends the report of Gerait Robery.

A gentle scenario for players who find it hard to earn a
CONGRATULATION this far in. It gives hands-on lessons in
which classes to send against which foes, which skills to
use, and so on.
